# Graphql Markdown v0.5.3 - Table of Contents

A simple GraphQL JSON Schema to  Markdown generator

## Pages

- [Readme](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [License](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/license.md)
- [Contributing](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/contributing.md)
- [Contributor Code of Conduct](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/code_of_conduct.md)
- [Changelog](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [GraphqlMarkdown](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/GraphqlMarkdown.md): Converts a GraphQL JSON schema to a markdown format

- [GraphqlMarkdown.MarkdownHelpers](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/GraphqlMarkdown.MarkdownHelpers.md): A set of helpers to generate proper markdown easily

- [GraphqlMarkdown.MultiPage](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/GraphqlMarkdown.MultiPage.md): Multi page generator from Graphql to Markdown

- [GraphqlMarkdown.OperationDetailsHelpers](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/GraphqlMarkdown.OperationDetailsHelpers.md): A set of helpers to generate query and mutation details.

- [GraphqlMarkdown.Renderer](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/GraphqlMarkdown.Renderer.md): A Genserver to renderer message to stiod by default or to file if specifying a filename when starting

- [GraphqlMarkdown.Schema](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/GraphqlMarkdown.Schema.md): Internal Schema representation of Graphql section we care about

- [GraphqlMarkdown.SinglePage](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/GraphqlMarkdown.SinglePage.md): Single page generator from Graphql to Markdown

## Mix Tasks

- [mix graphql_gen_markdown](https://graphql-markdown.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.GraphqlGenMarkdown.md): A mix task to convert a GraphQL JSON schema to markdown
